top_signals.title: SpaceX Bonds Weaken, Credit Risk Gauge Worsens On Debt Fears
top_signals.summary: SpaceX bonds weakened Wednesday after the company posted results that surpassed analysts’ estimates but also said it was investing aggressively, signaling more borrowing could be ahead.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
